topic: NASA 3D models, printing, images and textures
summary: NASA publishes downloadable mission-related 3D models, printable assets, images and textures. Hub: https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/ . Official mirror: https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources . A pinned inventory of all 1199 repository files is in knowledge/nasa_3d_inventory.json; it includes support files, so this is not a count of distinct models. No asset binaries are bundled.
